 Wizards vs. Rockets Discussion
 by Greg Finberg Nov 15, 2026, 10:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 WASHINGTON — The Washington Wizards (4-9) enter Sunday’s contest as losers of six straight games. Their recent 144-140 double-overtime loss to the Detroit Pistons was a step in the right direction. But they have a ways to go to get back to .500.
 That journey starts against the Houston Rockets (10-3) on Sunday at Capital One Arena.
 Here are the Wizards’ projected starters: 
 PG : Trae Young
 SG : AJ Dybantsa
 SF : Kyshawn George
 PF : Anthony Davis
 C : Alex Sarr
 Game information: 
 Opponent : Houston Rockets
 Tip-off : 7 p.m.
 Location : Capital One Arena
 TV : Monumental Sports Network 
 Radio : 106.7 The Fan 
 You can chat about the game in the comments below!
